---
title: "S10 Fig and S11 Fig — Cross-dataset phosphosite and phosphoprotein overlap"
author: "Sun et al."
output: html_document
---

**Purpose:** Supplemental Figures 10 and 11.

**S10 Fig:** UpSet plot comparing Rim15-dependent phosphosites (this study) with
4 published datasets at exact-site resolution (ORF + residue + position).

**S11 Fig:** Same comparison at the phosphoprotein level.

**Inputs:**
- `tables/DE_pSites_byGenotype.csv`
- `data/Phospho (STY)Sites.csv`
- `tables/normed_pSite_ratio_perseus.csv`
- Published dataset files in `data/Publications for comparative analysis/`
- UniProt reference proteome `data/Publications for comparative analysis/UP000002311_559292.fasta`

**Run from repo root:** `rmarkdown::render("sfig/SFig_10_11.Rmd")`

This script is a thin wrapper around `analyses/phosphosite_crossstudy.Rmd`, which
performs the full analysis. Run that script first to generate the membership CSVs,
then this script reads them and produces the final formatted figures.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.retina = 2)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(UpSetR)
library(cowplot)

out_dir  <- "sfig/plots"
data_dir <- "sfig/source_data"
dir.create(out_dir,  showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(data_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

out_r02 <- "./analyses/output"
```

```{r check-inputs}
site_path    <- file.path(out_r02, "phosphosite_membership.csv")
protein_path <- file.path(out_r02, "phosphoprotein_membership.csv")

if (!file.exists(site_path) || !file.exists(protein_path)) {
  stop("Membership tables not found.\n",
       "Run analyses/phosphosite_crossstudy.Rmd first to generate:\n",
       "  ", site_path, "\n  ", protein_path)
}

site_membership    <- read_csv(site_path,    show_col_types = FALSE)
protein_membership <- read_csv(protein_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
```

---

# S10 Fig — Phosphosite-level UpSet plot

Comparison of Rim15-dependent phosphosites from this study with four published
phosphoproteomic datasets (Li et al. 2019, Dokladal et al. 2021, Baro et al. 2018,
Plank et al. 2020) at exact-site resolution (ORF + residue + position).

```{r s10-upset}
set_names_ordered <- c("ThisStudy", "Li2019", "Dokladal2021",
                       "Baro2018", "Plank_Cdc55AID")

pdf(file.path(out_dir, "SFig10_phosphosite_upset.pdf"), width = 9, height = 5.5)
upset(as.data.frame(site_membership),
      sets            = set_names_ordered,
      keep.order      = TRUE,
      order.by        = "freq",
      mainbar.y.label = "Exact phosphosites (ORF + residue)",
      sets.x.label    = "Sites per dataset",
      text.scale      = c(1.4, 1.2, 1.2, 1.0, 1.4, 1.0))
dev.off()

upset(as.data.frame(site_membership),
      sets            = set_names_ordered,
      keep.order      = TRUE,
      order.by        = "freq",
      mainbar.y.label = "Exact phosphosites (ORF + residue)",
      sets.x.label    = "Sites per dataset")

# Source data = the full membership table
write_csv(site_membership %>%
            dplyr::select(key, orf, gene, aa, position,
                          all_of(set_names_ordered), n_published, category),
          file.path(data_dir, "SFig10_source_data.csv"))
message("SFig10: ", nrow(site_membership), " sites exported")
```

---

# S11 Fig — Phosphoprotein-level UpSet plot

Same comparison resolved at the protein level.

```{r s11-upset}
pdf(file.path(out_dir, "SFig11_phosphoprotein_upset.pdf"), width = 9, height = 5.5)
upset(as.data.frame(protein_membership),
      sets            = set_names_ordered,
      keep.order      = TRUE,
      order.by        = "freq",
      mainbar.y.label = "Phosphoproteins (ORF)",
      sets.x.label    = "Proteins per dataset",
      text.scale      = c(1.4, 1.2, 1.2, 1.0, 1.4, 1.0))
dev.off()

upset(as.data.frame(protein_membership),
      sets            = set_names_ordered,
      keep.order      = TRUE,
      order.by        = "freq",
      mainbar.y.label = "Phosphoproteins (ORF)",
      sets.x.label    = "Proteins per dataset")

write_csv(protein_membership %>%
            dplyr::select(orf, gene,
                          all_of(set_names_ordered), n_published),
          file.path(data_dir, "SFig11_source_data.csv"))
message("SFig11: ", nrow(protein_membership), " proteins exported")
```

## Summary statistics

```{r summary}
cat("=== Phosphosite-level ===\n")
cat("ThisStudy total:                  ", sum(site_membership$ThisStudy), "\n")
cat("Shared with >=1 published dataset:", sum(site_membership$ThisStudy == 1 &
                                               site_membership$n_published >= 1), "\n")
cat("Shared with >=2 published datasets:",sum(site_membership$ThisStudy == 1 &
                                               site_membership$n_published >= 2), "\n")
cat("Novel (not in any published):     ", sum(site_membership$ThisStudy == 1 &
                                               site_membership$n_published == 0), "\n\n")

cat("=== Phosphoprotein-level ===\n")
cat("ThisStudy total:                  ", sum(protein_membership$ThisStudy), "\n")
cat("Shared with >=1 published dataset:", sum(protein_membership$ThisStudy == 1 &
                                               protein_membership$n_published >= 1), "\n")
```
